title: Chapter 1293
text:
[Short Introduction: If you were asked to give up everything you have now and return to 18 years old, would you go back?]

[Melodramatic Introduction: Ye Ran fell down at the scene of her Oscar Best Actress Award Ceremony and returned to 18 years old. She is focused on finding a way to go back.]

— —

PY recommended an old driver's lifetime work, "The Heavenly Master Mad Doctor."

Introduction: A betrayal made him lose everything.

He decided to start all over again. He decided to act out the ugly side of life.

In life, sometimes it depended on skills, sometimes it depended on luck, and sometimes it depended on acting skills.

Hua Ruifeng quietly turned around. He had transformed beautifully. He simply took back everything and easily reached the peak again.

— —

PY recommended a book, "Returning to the Ming Dynasty to be a Fatuous Ruler," by Zhou Zhou.
